title: My medieval sandbox RPG has gone from a 2D pixel art prototype to a fully 3D world — here’s my latest trailer
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
Hey all, I’ve been developing Valdmark using Godot, Claude and ChatGPT, and the project has evolved quite a bit since I first started sharing it here.

https://ynotved.itch.io/valdmark

The biggest recent changes have been:  
\- Transitioning from 2D to 3D  
\- Adding optional third-person gameplay  
\- Modular construction and settlement building  
\- Interactive crafting and production systems  
\- Exploration and dungeon systems  
\- Trading, recruitment and tactical combat

I’ve been using ChatGPT for art direction, visual references and game design, while working with Claude on implementation and procedural asset creation in Godot.

I’ve also built an in-game director tool to help capture gameplay footage and put together trailers.  
Here’s the latest result. Everything shown is from the game itself.

Really excited to keep developing this!
